name: Taskbarchy
author: Xenobones
description: Windows 11 style taskbar/dock for Omarchy, exclusive with the Omarchy bar: hiding the bar brings the taskbar up with a live mirror of the bar's right-hand widgets, and a logo button in the bar brings it back. Personal fork of maximxmoroz.win11-dock; reads the same ~/.config/omarchy/win11-dock.json settings.

barWidget.description: Omarchy logo that swaps the bar for the Taskbarchy taskbar
